blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Central Abbotsford. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Central Abbotsford, Abbotsford: 79 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 6 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 9 Abbotsford communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Central Abbotsford rose from 73 in June to 79 in October (+8.2%), and 33 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 19.3% of Abbotsford’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Central Abbotsford?
Central Abbotsford also had 236 condos and townhomes listed and 42 sold in October, against 79 houses listed. The Central Abbotsford condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

77 houses sold in Central Abbotsford with a median price of $980,000 (the middle half sold between $895,000 and $1,115,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $400 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 7,282 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 79 houses listed in Central Abbotsford. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Abbotsford a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Central Abbotsford had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central Abbotsford from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 33 houses sold in Central Abbotsford over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Central Abbotsford sell for?
faq.a: 77 houses sold in Central Abbotsford between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $980,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
